label: First Vatican Council, Dei Filius Ch. 3…… supports The Catholic Church is a visible society…
note: Dei Filius ch. 3 says God instituted the Church through his only-begotten Son, as guardian and teacher of the revealed word. Reading 'through the Son' as Jesus' founding act, and the instituted Church as the Catholic Church as a visible society with authority, is the analyst's reading of the encoded statement.
